headline: Frank Lampard values Coventry's hard work after first Premier League win in 25 years
description: Frank Lampard said he was grateful for his team's work ethic after Coventry ended a four-game losing streak to claim their first Premier League win for 25 years.

headline: Premier League VAR review: Was Rice lucky not to be sent off at Brighton?
description: VAR often causes controversy, but how are decisions made? Our resident ref, Andy Davies, explains all.

headline: European soccer recap: Brighton humble Arsenal, Villa keep Spurs winless
description: Another weekend of European soccer action continues with Brighton & Hove Albion hosting Premier League leaders and defending champions Arsenal.

headline: Coventry claim first Premier League win of season at Nottingham Forest
description: Jay DaSilva fired Coventry to their first Premier League win in 25 years as they beat Nottingham Forest 1-0 in another game mired by VAR controversy.

headline: Arteta 'extremely disappointed' as Arsenal fall to Brighton
description: Arteta 'extremely disappointed' as Arsenal fall to Brighton

headline: Arsenal's aura of champions evaporates after Brighton thrash them 3-0
description: The strengths that won Arsenal the title deserted them at Brighton, which celebrated their 125th anniversary with a thumping victory over the champions.
